there are any changes in the VEKN tournament rules for 2009.

www.white-wolf.com/vtes/index.php?line=veknRules) in the sidebar of

If you mean in time for the Jan 1st announcement, that still has 3 days
left. If you mean a pre-announcement announcement of rules changes, I'm
just wondering how pre-pre-pre-pre you need the announcements? For
instance, maybe LSJ could announce on Jan 1 2009 that there will be
rules tweaks announced on Jan 1 2010?

In regards to the web page design, I think everyone, even probably the
WW/CCP employee responsible for the web content would agree that the
VTES page needs a tune-up, if not a complete overhaul. But that might
require time and money, and it works "o.k." now, so why fix what isn't
terribly broke?

best -

chris

The past changes to the tournament rules were posted approx. 4 weeks
before the end of the year:
Tournament Rules For -- Posted in the Newsgroup
2008 -- Dec 4th, 2007
2007 -- Dec 1st, 2006
2006 -- ???
2005 -- Dec, 4th, 2004

I find these 4 weeks a resonable timeframe for players, organizers and
VEKN to adjust to the new tournament rules. This year the announcement
of the new VEKN tournament rules are little late, considering that
there are tournaments in the WW event calendar for Jan 2nd, 3rd and
4th and Oscar's announcement that most of the WW staff will be back at
Jan 5th.
